title: Need beta testers for arcade chess concept
author: ComprehensiveLime654
selftext:
I’m making a variation of a chess game where the pieces have a head to head fight instead of it being an easy capture. 

The game still does follow chess rules and flow to a large degree—an example is that I made it so if you’re the initiator of the attacker you start with a special bonus and you actually can’t die just from attacking (you just return to your square), and undefended pieces are taken as an easy capture just as in normal chess. 

I’ve balanced the pieces enough to follow traditional chess piece values (pawn 1, knight/bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9) so a pawn can’t actually kill a queen unless in a major upset. With that said, the balancing has all been done through cpu simulations and I need some human testers :)

Try it out at arcadechess.app 

The game has not been polished. And that’s kind of the point of asking for beta users—I’m well aware the balancing might feel off once users try themselves, and constructive feedback is what I’m looking does

replies.author: int21hstudios
replies.body:
This seems more Archon ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o6HYbQCRwgk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o6HYbQCRwgk)) than Battle Chess.

If I remember correctly battle chess didn't change chess rules it just animated piece taking.  This looks like a pawn could technically defeat a queen in a street fighter type battle (though I imagine it would be difficult)
